system_prompt_style.note: No prompt-building code or template file available in evidence; only README prose.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: workers each claim one and run real commands
env_context_strategy.note: Workers shell out and explore/run commands; no context-injection mechanism described.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: the Reason planner won't autonomously plan challenges or summarize progress
context_compaction.note: Coordinator 'intelligently coordinates and controls each agent's context'; inferred summarization, no code shown.

observation_format.evidence_quote: the results are written back to the blackboard via the skill
observation_format.note: Tool/command output written as facts; inferred plain text.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: It drives CLI agents to execute commands, invoke security tools, and reach target services
tool_call_format.note: Muteki shells out to worker CLIs which run real commands; underlying per-engine call format not exposed.

tool_count.note: No tool schema list available; workers are external CLIs.

edit_primitive.note: No edit tool definition available; editing done by external engine CLIs.

tool_schema_source.note: muteki-blackboard skill mentioned but no schema source code shown.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: It all relies on the `muteki-blackboard` skill built into every worker — this is the only data channel between a worker and the blackboard
protocol_standardization.note: Proprietary skill channel; no MCP/A2A mentioned, but no registry opened.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: the four phases of a single run; the inner `(1)~(5)` are the per-tick collaboration loop
loop_primitives.note: Four-phase pipeline; race/multi-engine attempts; event stream (jsonl) drives replay.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: an intent goes onto the blackboard → workers each claim one and run real commands
planning_granularity.note: Shared blackboard stores facts/intents/dead-ends as structured state read/written across steps.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: the coordinator reads the blackboard → Reason plans the next step → an intent goes onto the blackboard → workers each claim one
multi_agent_topology.note: Coordinator orchestrates a swarm of heterogeneous workers.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: `(1)~(5)` keeps looping, expanding the swarm as evidence grows
delegation_mechanism.note: Coordinator launches/expands worker agents (web-api docker runs one per run).

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: you can use the "x" in the top-right to report a specific flag as a false positive, which will spin workers back up
human_in_loop.note: Operator can stop the run or reject a flag after completion.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: Shared blackboard: event-sourced SQLite, the single source of truth (facts/intents/dead-ends/...)

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: Wind-down only clears the non-winner scratch under `workers/`
long_term_memory.note: Blackboard is per-run; no cross-run memory re-injection described.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: the source of truth for SSE replay / resume (one line = one event)
state_persistence.note: Event stream supports replay/resume; winner.json is a continuation handle.

self_verification.evidence_quote: a flag is accepted only when it appears verbatim in real execution output
self_verification.note: Provenance gate verifies flags against execution output; periodic review verifies recorded facts.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: The blackboard keeps growing until there's enough for a flag
retry_policy.note: Loop continues until flag passes the gate or budget exhausted.

rollback.note: No revert/rollback mechanism for agent changes described (repo rollback in README refers to app version upgrades).

termination_condition.evidence_quote: Enough for a flag / operator stops / budget exhausted
termination_condition.note: Flag found (test_pass), budget exhausted (cost_cap), operator stop.

cost_controls.note: Budget/cost tracking; token and cost totals reported.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: workers run either as host CLIs (`local` backend) or as sibling containers (`container` backend)
execution_isolation.note: Local (host CLI subprocess) is the recommended default; container backend reachable.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: run it straight on my own computer all the time
filesystem_access.note: In local mode workers run as host CLIs with host filesystem access; container mode uses workspace mounts.

network_policy.evidence_quote: keeps the network open, and lets workers improvise freely

permission_model.evidence_quote: lets workers improvise freely — writing and installing their own dependencies and scripts
permission_model.note: No per-action authorization; workers execute freely; trust boundary warns of no isolation.

tracing.evidence_quote: The "event stream" for this challenge: the source of truth for SSE replay / resume (one line = one event)

replayability.note: Event stream replayable to frontend; environment/model outputs not bit-for-bit.

eval_hooks.note: eval_nyu reports and scripts/ eval harness ship in repo.

guardrails.evidence_quote: a flag is accepted only when it appears verbatim in real execution output
guardrails.note: Provenance gate validates flags; no input/output safety filters described (offensive tool, no isolation promised).

target_domain.evidence_quote: autonomous multi-model CTF-solving AI agent swarm
target_domain.note: Offensive/defensive security automation, CTF, pentesting; not conventional SWE.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: You can also configure a **custom OpenAI-compatible endpoint** (`base_url` + key) in a worker profile
model_agnostic.note: Nine engine CLIs plus custom endpoints supported.

first_release_date.note: Only pinned tag date available; earlier release dates not in evidence.

stars.note: Star count not stated in evidence.
